result.markdown: --- title: "[Graph.get_overlap_similarity()]{.doc-object-name .doc-function .doc-label .doc-label-method}" body-classes: doc-api-page doc-py-api-page shift-heading-level-by: 0 toc-depth: 3 page-navigation: false html-table-processing: none --- ::: {.doc-subject} Get overlap coefficient between all node pairs. ::: ::: {.doc-usage-source} Usage [Source](https://github.com/rich-iannone/edgecase/blob/main/python/edgecase/graph.py#L9275-L9326){target="_blank" rel="noopener"} ::: ::: {.doc-signature .doc-Kind.FUNCTION} ```python Graph.get_overlap_similarity() ``` ::: ::: {.doc-text} The overlap coefficient emphasizes subset relationships: `Overlap(A, B) = |neighbors(A) ∩ neighbors(B)| / min(|neighbors(A)|, |neighbors(B)|)` Range: `[0, 1]` where `0` means no common neighbors and `1` means one neighborhood is a subset of the other. Asymmetric measure useful for hierarchical patterns. Self-similarity is always `1.0`. ::: ## Returns {.doc-returns} ::: {.doc-definition-items} [dict[int, dict[int, float]]]{.doc-parameter-annotation} : Nested dictionary mapping node IDs to dictionaries of similarity scores. Format: `{node1_id: {node2_id: similarity_score}}`. ::: ## Common Use Cases {.doc-common-use-cases} - detecting specialization/generalization - finding hubs whose neighbors are subsets of others - hierarchical community structure ## Examples {.doc-examples} Unlike Jaccard or Dice, overlap divides by the *smaller* neighborhood size rather than the union or sum, which is what makes it useful for spotting subset relationships between a specialized node and a more general one: ::: {#663cd464 .cell execution_count=1} ``` {.python .cell-code} import edgecase as ec graph = ( ec.Graph() .add_node(label="hub") .add_node(label="spoke") .add_node(label="extended") .add_node(label="extra") .add_edge(source="hub", target="spoke") .add_edge(source="hub", target="extended") .add_edge(source="spoke", target="extra") ) sim = graph.get_overlap_similarity() hub_id = graph.get_id_from_label(label="hub") spoke_id = graph.get_id_from_label(label="spoke") sim[hub_id][spoke_id] ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-display execution_count=1} ``` 0.0 ``` ::: :::
